channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Peru: Two Trains Carrying Tourists to Machu Picchu Collide, Leaving One Dead and Several Injured
item.description: A fatal head-on train collision near Machu Picchu in Peru killed a driver and injured dozens of international tourists.

item.title: 25-Year-Old MP Passenger Beaten with Belt, Sticks Over ₹20 Thali Overcharge on Andaman Express at Jhansi
item.description: 25-year-old MP passenger beaten with belts, sticks by Jhansi train vendors over ₹20 thali overcharge, igniting railway catering outrage.

item.title: 18-Year-Old Indian Navy Alumna Kaamya Karthikeyan Skis 115km to South Pole, Youngest Ever Record
item.description: An 18-year-old Mumbai mountaineering prodigy and Navy officer's daughter skis 115km to the South Pole, becoming India's youngest while targeting the Explorers Grand Slam.

item.title: Swiggy, Zomato, Blinkit Delivery Workers on Nationwide Strike: Key Demands & New Year’s Eve Disruptions
item.description: A massive nationwide strike by 1.5 lakh gig workers has disrupted New Year's Eve deliveries across India.

item.title: UP-Backed Shankh Airlines Set for January 2026 Launch, Promises Affordable Fares, Tourism and Employment
item.description: Uttar Pradesh's new state-backed carrier Shankh Airlines eyes affordable regional flights from Lucknow, promising jobs, tourism boost, and global expansion by 2028.

item.title: Consumer Court Awards ₹20 Lakh Compensation After Delayed Diagnosis of Ectopic Pregnancy Leads to Infertility
item.description: A Delhi nursing home must pay ₹20 lakh after medical negligence led to a woman's permanent infertility.

item.title: People of Purpose: Shaheen Malik Turns Acid Attack Scars into Strength Through Brave Souls Foundation
item.description: Shaheen Malik survived a 2009 Panipat acid attack, endured 25 surgeries, and saw the accused acquitted in 2025.

item.title: Ceasefire Was Bilateral, Not Brokered: India Firmly Rejects China’s Mediation Claim with Pakistan
item.description: India has reiterated that direct military talks-not third-party mediation-ended the brief but tense May standoff with Pakistan.

item.title: CM Siddaramaiah Orders 20,000 Cops, Drones, Extra Buses for Safe Bengaluru New Year 2026 Celebrations
item.description: CM Siddaramaiah orders massive police, tech deployment for women's safety, zero incidents in Bengaluru New Year 2026 festivities.

item.title: Over 60 Injured as Worker Trains Collide Inside Uttarakhand Hydropower Tunnel in Chamoli; Safety Lapses Under Probe
item.description: A late-night collision of worker trains in Chamoli's Tapovan tunnel injures 60, sparking urgent rescues and renewed calls for hydropower safety reforms.
